muxt generate --use-datastar --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /page Page(ctx)" -}}{{ (.Actions.Show .Result).URL }}{{- end -}}
{{- define "GET /records/{slug} Show(ctx, slug)" -}}{{ .Result }}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

// Page emits the encoded URL for a hostile slug so the test can request it
// back through the generated mux.
func (Server) Page(_ context.Context) (string, error) {
	return "a/b?c=d 'x'", nil
}

func (Server) Show(_ context.Context, slug string) (string, error) { return slug, nil }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"html"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/page", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	encodedURL := html.UnescapeString(strings.TrimSpace(rec.Body.String()))
	if strings.Contains(encodedURL, "?") || strings.Count(strings.TrimPrefix(encodedURL, "/"), "/") != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("encoded URL %q must be /records/<one-encoded-segment>", encodedURL)
	}

	// Requesting the encoded URL proves encode/decode symmetry end to end:
	// the handler's request.PathValue sees the original decoded value.
	req = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, encodedURL, nil)
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if want := "a/b?c=d &#39;x&#39;"; rec.Body.String() != want {
		t.Errorf("round-tripped body = %q, want the HTML-escaped original %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
	}
}
